TEXTKEY_NodeF010_DESC:
As you whistle off-beat, a crow slips from the thorn vines and perches on your arm. Its eyes glow blue, a gravelly voice breaking forth.

<color=#a69085>"Report, Expedition Commander."</color>

The crow tilts its head, unblinking.

<color=#a69085>"…You claimed the lower levels were safe. Clearly, they are not."</color>

You explain that your first scouting mission ended in a deadly encounter with the infamous <color=#a69085>'Red Monster Rat'</color>, leaving most of your party slain.

<color=#a69085>"Then scouting is meaningless. I’ll send you a new recruit, Kragas. Establish an outpost according to guild protocol, and prepare to strike the beast before it spreads further ruin."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF300_DESC:
Through the mist-shrouded vines, a crow flies low before settling on your forearm.

<color=#a69085>"Damn! That thing has already wiped out two more expedition teams while we waited. We need to hurry and take it down."</color>

You report the recent situation of the expedition teams. When you mention that you do not have enough members to take down the Red Monster Rat, the inspector cuts you off.

<color=#a69085>"Why didn't you say so sooner? Taking down that monster is urgent! I will provide the funds, so recruit the members yourself."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF800_DESC:
Communication begins, and you thrust the severed head of the enormous rat before the raven's eyes.

<color=#a69085>"So you really did kill it. I can't say I expected much..."</color>

The raven pecks at the severed head of the Red Monster Rat as if performing an autopsy, but it is now little more than a filthy lump of blood-soaked flesh.

<color=#a69085>"Do you know how many lives that thing has claimed recently? If you had been a little faster, some of them might still be alive. Well, just an observation."</color>

Your expression hardens at the inspector's blunt tone, but he pays no mind and continues grumbling.

<color=#a69085>"In less than a year, more than half the continent has been swallowed by thorned vines spreading from the dungeons. Yes, much like the Barren Land where you now live. Hurry your expedition along. We must conquer the dungeons before we meet a dreadful end."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF900_DESC:
Though your comrades’ vengeance has been fulfilled, a bitter feeling lingers within you. The dead cannot be brought back.

Once the report concludes, the expedition members gradually gather around you. They wish to hear your thoughts on the path ahead.
TEXTKEY_NodeF911_DESC:
As you wave them off, the expedition members scratch their heads and return to their duties.

Surely the Expedition Leader already has a solid plan in mind!

TIP : You can use [ITEM_ExpeditionHorn] to resume Expedition Resolutions.
[ITEM_ExpeditionHorn] is sold by the Guild Merchant.

Complete Expedition Resolutions to earn a small amount of Contribution.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1100_DESC:
The moment you think surviving was a miracle, you hear the crow’s wings flapping again. You cling to consciousness and haul yourself upright. The crow lands on your arm and opens its beak.

<color=#a69085>"First annihilation, huh… You lasted longer than I expected."</color>

The inspector shakes his head and sighs.

<color=#a69085>"Preparation was lacking from the start. No base near the portal, lack of expedition members… Still, I’ll give you another chance."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF1200_DESC:
The crow looks down at you, tilts its beak, and says with an oddly playful tone,

<color=#a69085>"Listen, there is only so much I can do to help. If you get wiped out again, we will really be in trouble."</color>

After a brief silence, the inspector's voice continues.

<color=#a69085>"If you fall apart again, I will not say another word."</color>

The crow shakes one wing and flies back into the mist. You press your lips together and begin preparing once more.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1300_DESC:
Less than a day had passed before you ordered the expedition members to deal with the suspicious member. You did not know how something like this could have happened, but the members were relieved for now. Still, a faint unease lingered in the corner of your mind. 

'What if the {0} I dealt with was the real {0}?' 

You shake your head and push the needless thought away.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1400_DESC: A day has passed, and now it is time to decide what to do with {0}.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1410_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"No! I'm real! I'm the real one!"</color>

You hear {0} scream and coldly turn your head away. 

No matter how you look at it, this is far too suspicious. There is no need to take an unnecessary risk.
A few members look strangely uneasy, but most seem relieved.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1411_DESC:
You examined the situation from several angles, but found nothing immediately suspicious. 

You have not completely set aside your doubts, but you should welcome them back alive all the same.

With an unpleasant aftertaste and the members' murmuring behind you, you held a brief moment to celebrate {0}'s return.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1500_DESC:
As soon as you return to the settlement, you witness two members bickering.

<color=#a69085>"Leader! I'm telling you, that one is suspicious no matter how you look at it! They were suspicious from the moment they suddenly showed up alone!"</color>

{1} fumes in anger the moment they see you.
They show you their wounds and claim they were attacked.

<color=#a69085>"Leader. All I did was catch that one trying to secretly lay hands on the expedition's valuables. Then that one slipped on their own and blamed me for it!"</color>

{0} looks at you with an expression of wounded injustice.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1510_DESC:
{0} has been suspicious ever since they returned. You still cannot trust them! 

You order the members to seize {0}.

{0} struggles and looks up at you desperately.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1511_DESC:
{0} seemed suspicious, but you decided that {1}, who had tried to steal, was worse after all.

{0} thanks you for your trust.
TEXTKEY_NodeF1600_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Wait, wait. Just calm down for a second."</color>

The scarecrow urgently stops you.

<color=#a69085>"Do you... have any idea how lonely it is here? I'm all alone, all day long..."</color>

As you casually raise your hand, the scarecrow flinches again and continues.

<color=#a69085>"That's why I did it. Because I was lonely. If I don't do something like this, no one ever looks at me."</color>

You can hear a certain desperation in the scarecrow's voice.

<color=#a69085>"Ah! I've got a good idea. Why don't you take me with you?"</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF1700_DESC:
As you purchase the merchant's scale, she stares at you intently.

<color=#a69085>"Do you even know what you just bought?"</color>

When you shake your head, she explains as though she expected that answer.

<color=#a69085>"With that scale, you can officially establish a Merchant Chamber. Once it's built, a merchant from the guild will be sent to manage it."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF1800_DESC:
Not long after the Merchant Chamber is completed, a merchant is dispatched from the guild. After settling her belongings into the chamber, she approaches you carrying a stack of documents.

<color=#a69085>"Well, would you look at that. You're the commander here? What a coincidence..."</color>

She trails off, then points through several entries on the list as she explains.

<color=#a69085>"These here are the goods that'll be traded through this place, so take a good look. I'll keep the stock replenished regularly, so don't worry about that."</color>

After getting a few signatures from you, she returns to the Merchant Chamber.
TEXTKEY_NodeF2800_DESC:
It appears to have been abandoned for a long time, but it does not seem to have stopped functioning entirely.

The pipes are corroded in places, and pools of contaminated water—apparently leaked catalyst—have collected nearby.
TEXTKEY_NodeF2810_DESC:
{0} cautiously touches the device's controls, and it begins to awaken with a low vibration.

<color=#a69085>"Hummm..."</color>

The catalyst inside the vessel churns, and the intricate mana circuits flicker back to life one by one.

For a brief moment, {0} is struck by a powerful flash of insight, as though they have grasped the principles governing the flow of mana.

But then the entire device begins to shake violently.

<color=#a69085>"Bzzzt... Bzzt!"</color>

The next instant, the device shatters, spraying corrupted catalyst in every direction.
TEXTKEY_NodeF2811_DESC:
{0} circles the device, carefully removing each part that still appears intact.

Once everything useful has been salvaged, nothing remains of the discarded mana device but a worthless heap of scrap metal.
TEXTKEY_NodeF2900_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Bwoooong-"</color>

As you sound the expedition horn, the expedition members gather around.

<color=#a69085>"It seems we need a new approach when it comes to setting and achieving our expedition goals."</color>

You clear your throat before continuing.

<color=#a69085>"Listen well, everyone. From this point onward, we shall..."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF3000_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"It seems our progress toward the objective has slowed, commander."</color>

The expedition members have begun to doubt the expedition's recent ability to achieve its goals.

<color=#a69085>"Isn’t it a waste of time to keep chasing something that clearly isn’t working?"</color>

You had thought the objective would be completed quickly, but it has proven far less simple than expected.

You fall into deep thought.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3010_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Hmm... if you say so..."</color>

When you assure them that the objective will soon be accomplished, the expedition members reluctantly nod.

<color=#a69085>"Well then, surely the commander has a proper plan."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF3011_DESC:
You explain to the expedition members why the current expedition objective is realistically difficult to achieve.

<color=#a69085>"Then why did we even set such a goal in the first place?"</color>

A few expedition members grumble and voice their dissatisfaction.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3100_DESC:
A raven flies in from afar and lands upon your forearm.

<color=#a69085>"To be honest, I did not expect your group to last very long. Yet, I suppose I must admit I was wrong. Surviving in the Barren Land is no easy feat in itself."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Perhaps we might have achieved even greater results had the guild offered more support, inspector."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Yes, yes, I hear you. I’ll send a few supplies your way, so make good use of them. And it seems a handful of people have shown interest in joining your expedition as well."</color>

The raven tilts its head slightly before bluntly pecking at your chest with its beak.

<color=#a69085>"But don’t let it go to your head. You still have a long road ahead. Just keep up the good work, understood?"</color>

With those words, the raven disappears into the darkness with a rough beat of its wings.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3200_DESC:
<color=#a69085>“I've been hearing stories about your group everywhere lately.”</color>

The Inspector's voice flows from the raven's beak.

<color=#a69085>“It seems you're finally beginning to look like a proper expedition. Even the Guild has started treating you as a fairly capable outfit.”</color>

<color=#a69085>"Wondering how we're still alive, are you?"</color>

At your grumbling, the raven caws and ruffles its feathers.

<color=#a69085>“Now, now. In any case, the support you receive will improve from here on out. Of course, we'll expect results to match. And it seems the time has come for you to appoint a deputy commander. I'll send you an insignia; the appointment is yours to make.”</color>

With that, the raven spreads its black wings and vanishes beyond the sky.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3300_DESC:
The newly appointed Deputy Commander, {0}, respectfully receives the insignia you present with both hands.
Then, turning around, they look proudly upon the members and strike the ground sharply with their tail.

<color=#a69085>"Rak'tor! The chief chose me. Now I am the greatest warrior."</color>

The nearby members answer the declaration with cheers.

<color=#a69085>"The greatest warrior fights at the front. I will tear apart anyone who blocks the chief's path."</color>

{0} bares their fangs in a broad grin.

<color=#a69085>"Behold my strength. All will know that the chief's choice was right."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF3400_DESC:
The newly appointed deputy commander, {0}, summons the expedition members to the campfire.

<color=#a69085>"The Dungeon will not welcome us. It will test us without end and, in the end, try to swallow us whole."</color>

After a brief silence, {0} slowly looks over the assembled members.

<color=#a69085>"But what will fear alone accomplish? If this apocalypse is to end, someone must take the first step. Come with me, all of you, into the deepest darkness."</color>

The expedition members erupt in cheers at {0}'s speech, firm resolve swelling in every heart.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3500_DESC:
The newly appointed deputy commander, {0}, quietly accepts the insignia from you. They close their eyes for a moment and draw a breath as though catching a scent, then slowly survey the expedition members.

<color=#a69085>"Monsters always strike when you look weakest. But that is precisely when the real fight begins."</color>

{0} bares sharp fangs in a faint smile.

<color=#a69085>"Remember this: the more blood you lose and the harsher your breathing becomes, the sharper your senses will grow."</color>

The expedition members' eyes naturally turn toward {0}.

<color=#a69085>"Think you're about to fall? Nonsense. Survive to the very end—and tear out their throats."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF3600_DESC:
The raven perched on your forearm glows blue in the eyes.
A gruff male voice soon issues from its beak.

<color=#a69085>"I've received a report that the position of deputy commander in your expedition is vacant."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Well... there were circumstances."</color>

The Inspector grumbles in exasperation, then continues his lecture.

<color=#a69085>"The deeper your expedition ventures, the harder it will become for you to handle everything alone. Do you understand? Appoint a new deputy commander as soon as you can. "</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF3700_DESC:
The newly appointed deputy commander, {0}, calmly surveys the expedition members.

<color=#a69085>"The Dungeon is consuming the continent. If we fail to stop this calamity, the forests and rivers—and eventually even the World Tree—will wither away."</color>

After a brief silence, {0} continues in a resolute voice.

<color=#a69085>"Remember this: the blessing of the sacred World Tree will be with us on our journey."</color>

The expedition members steel themselves, their expressions firm with resolve.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3800_DESC:
The expedition’s ultimate goal is to destroy the core of Arcteon, the self-aware dungeon, and bring an end to the terrible apocalypse that has come upon the world. Since the recent expeditions have failed to produce any visible results, the expedition members seem to be growing restless.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, what if we go deeper on the next expedition?"</color>

Someone makes the suggestion loudly in front of all the gathered members.

<color=#a69085>"If we stop here, everyone will think we’re cowards."</color>

After deep consideration, you realize that now, while the members are filled with motivation, may be the perfect opportunity to move on to the next stage of the expedition.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3900_DESC:
A noisy murmur rises as the expedition members come to see you. Among them, {0} steps forward with a determined look.

<color=#a69085>"We cannot take this anymore. We are risking our lives, yet the food is awful and we get hardly any time to rest!"</color>

As {0} shouts in agitation, the other members bristle and voice their agreement.

<color=#a69085>"That's right! We cannot take this anymore!"</color>

The exhausted members air their grievances one after another, and the mood turns hostile. When you raise a hand to stop {0}, everyone falls silent and waits for you to speak.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3910_DESC:
At your words, the expedition members' expressions shift from anger to surprise and delight, and the hostile mood begins to ease.

<color=#a69085>"Is that true, Commander?"</color>

As though they had not been furious only moments ago, {0} asks with a smile.

<color=#a69085>"Of course. I know how hard all of you have been working. Use these gold coins to unwind, then come back refreshed."</color>

Satisfied with your decision, the expedition members smile and return to their posts.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3911_DESC:
As the surroundings grow quiet, you slowly continue.

<color=#a69085>"I know how hard all of you have been fighting. Things are difficult now, but once we overcome this crisis, our situation will be much better."</color>

The expedition members' expressions gradually soften at your words.

<color=#a69085>"So endure just a little longer. I will not let your hardship go to waste."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Understood, Commander. We will keep going a little longer."</color>

{0} and the other members nod, accepting your words.
TEXTKEY_NodeF3912_DESC:
Your persuasion seems to quiet them for a moment, but the expedition members' discontent does not subside so easily. {0} raises their voice once more.

<color=#a69085>"Do not try to placate us with honeyed words! We have already endured more than enough, and the time for calming down and listening to the Commander is long past!"</color>

Their complaints grow louder, and the tension in the room continues to rise. Unfortunately, your attempt has failed. They still glare at you, furious and exhausted. With nothing resolved, a heavy silence hangs in the air.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4000_DESC:
The expedition members gather to celebrate the success of this expedition. You look around at everyone before slowly beginning to speak.

<color=#a69085>"We did it! We conquered the Veil of Silence, that dark and dangerous forest. This victory was made possible by the courage and resolve of everyone here."</color>

When you finish speaking, the expedition members break into applause and cheers.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, now that we've eliminated the threats, the guild should be able to secure the deepest reaches of the Veil of Silence as a forward base for further development."</color>

You nod at the member's words.

<color=#a69085>"Good. Then we can advance to the next region."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF4100_DESC:
The expedition members gather one by one to celebrate the success of this expedition. Their armor is still caked with filth and dust, but no one pays it any mind. Once every eye is on you, you raise your voice.

<color=#a69085>"We conquered that accursed tunnel. We brought down the rotting refuse and every hideous monster within it."</color>

The expedition members slap one another on the back and burst into cheers. Laughter rings out all around.

<color=#a69085>"But this is not the end. The heart of the calamity still awaits us deeper below. Carry today's victory in your hearts—and tomorrow, let us march into even deeper darkness!"</color>

At your signal, the expedition members let out a mighty roar and celebrate their victory together.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4200_DESC:
As you organize the report on the expedition, a raven flies down and lands on your arm.

<color=#a69085>"Greetings, brother."</color>

You realize that a priest of the Order is speaking to you through the raven.

<color=#a69085>"Even in such a barren place, a statue of the Goddess must be raised so that Her faithful may offer their prayers. Expedition members who have gained sufficient experience will also earn the right to receive Her blessing."</color>

After preaching at length that building the statue is an obligation rather than a choice, he stresses that you must not neglect your prayers.

<color=#a69085>"I will also send a small amount of provisions for your daily needs. May the Goddess watch over you."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF4500_DESC:
You discover goblins sleeping inside enormous glass tanks. Unlike ordinary green-skinned goblins, however, these specimens have bluish skin and far more powerful builds.

The tanks are filled with an unidentified liquid, and the specimens float motionless within as though asleep.

An intricate array of buttons and levers—whose purpose is impossible to discern—is connected to each tank.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4510_DESC:
The liquid inside the glass tanks slowly begins to swirl, and the fingers of the sleeping goblins twitch ever so slightly.

A moment later, their tightly shut eyes slowly open. Instinct tells you at once that they are dangerous.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4511_DESC:
The device does not respond, no matter which buttons you press or levers you pull. Time appears to have destroyed its core functions beyond repair.

While examining the device, you discover several old books stored inside a compartment.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4600_DESC:
You discover a fissure split across the floor. From within the darkness, you feel something watching you.

<color=#a69085>Thump, thump, thump.</color>

A pulse echoes from beneath the fleshy floor. It waits for your response.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4610_DESC:
When you hold the meat before the fissure, thin strands of flesh reach out and coil around the meat alone. After it vanishes into the darkness, the entire room contracts once with tremendous force.

<color=#a69085>'Ra... Gust Stism...' </color>

There is no sound of chewing. Perhaps it is simply beyond your hearing. Instead, a warm vibration travels through the floor beneath the expedition members' feet.

After a moment, the fissure opens again. It appears to be waiting for the next offering.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4620_DESC:
<color=#a69085>Sho,,,,geoo,,s.,.. </color>

As the second piece of meat disappears, two small lumps rise in succession along the edge of the fissure, then sink back down.

When an expedition member moves to take out another chunk of meat, the fissure slowly tilts in that direction. It now seems able to sense not only the smell of meat, but also who is carrying it.

From deep within comes the faint sound of hard objects striking one another.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4630_DESC:
Immediately after swallowing the third piece of meat, the room's pulse abruptly stops.

A moment later, the fissure twists as though retching and spits Mana Stones from its dark crimson mucus.

Whether it is paying for its meal or coughing up pearl-like stones formed within its body is impossible to know.

Even after yielding the Mana Stones, the fissure does not close. It still wants more.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4640_DESC:
When you offer the fourth piece, something inside takes only the meat without touching your fingers. Its movement is more careful and practiced than before.

Soon, the veins in the walls and floor begin beating at the same pace as the expedition members' hearts. Yet there is no telling whose heartbeat they are following. Even when one member holds their breath, the chamber's rhythm does not falter.

The slit opens a little wider than before.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4650_DESC:
As the fifth piece of meat disappears, the room fills with a scent like ginger and mustard burning in a fire.

Yet each expedition member describes a different smell. One catches spices, another scorched fat, and another the dinner table of a home left behind long ago.

<color=#a69085>Clatter. Creak. Crunch.</color>

From within the fissure comes the sound of a tongueless mouth savoring its meal.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4660_DESC:
After swallowing the sixth piece of meat, the fissure contracts slowly six times, then falls still.

<color=#a69085>Creeeak! Tick... taste... ting!</color>

In the silence, three clear chimes ring out, like glass bottles striking one another. Yes—the sound you just heard could not possibly have come from inside a living creature.

The fissure remains open, deeper and wider than before, waiting for another hand to reach out.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4670_DESC:
As the seventh piece of meat disappears into the darkness, the flesh covering the room contracts all at once.

Deep within the fissure, something moves like a gigantic eyelid closing, pushing out a stream of clear mucus. The fissure then slowly seals shut.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4700_DESC:
A raven flies over the thorny vines and settles on your arm.
Its eyes glow blue, and a man's voice issues from its beak.

<color=#a69085>"The Dungeon is becoming far more dangerous than we once knew. First, follow standard Guild protocol and make the basic preparations you'll need to survive down there."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Don't worry, Inspector. I know every precaution by heart."</color>

Your answer does little to reassure him. 

<color=#a69085>"Quite confident, aren't you...? Well, you'll understand once you experience it for yourself. Good fortune to you, Expedition Commander."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeF4800_DESC:
After receiving the report that construction of the basic settlement is complete, the Inspector speaks in an even voice.

<color=#a69085>"Then at last, you can begin the expedition. As you know, those accursed thorny vines are swallowing the continent even as we speak."</color>

He pauses, then adds in a low voice.

<color=#a69085>"Expeditions are dispatched across the continent, but few survive in the abandoned lands. Don't let your guard down."</color>

Having said his piece, the raven beats its wings and takes flight.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4900_DESC:
You have established a basic base of operations, but the expedition has only just begun to take shape.

Once the report is finished, the expedition members gather around you one by one. They want to hear how you intend to proceed.
TEXTKEY_NodeF4911_DESC:
As you wave them off, the expedition members scratch their heads and return to their duties.

Surely the Expedition Leader already has a solid plan in mind!

TIP : You can use [ITEM_ExpeditionHorn] to resume Expedition Resolutions.
[ITEM_ExpeditionHorn] is sold by the Guild Merchant.

Complete Expedition Resolutions to earn a small amount of Contribution.
TEXTKEY_NodeF5000_DESC:
A raven flies down and lands on your arm.

<color=#a69085>"I hear you have been making quite a name for yourself lately."</color>

The Inspector remarks that your recent achievements have been rather encouraging. After a brief pause, he continues.

<color=#a69085>"However... a suspicious passage has recently been discovered in the deepest reaches of the Dungeon. The Guild calls that place the Abyss. My instincts warn me that something dangerous lies beyond it."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Does that mean you want us to explore it?"</color>

The Inspector responds to your question with caution.

<color=#a69085>"No. I merely wanted you to know that something is there. You could venture deeper than you do now, but the choice is entirely yours."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN000_DESC:
Judging from her appearance, she is a merchant sent by the guild into the dungeon.
She is organizing goods and writing in a ledger when her ears perk up as you approach.

<color=#a69085>"See that pile of rocks over there? It is not moving right now, but I hear the guild will send people to investigate it soon."</color>

<color=#a69085>"This cannot be... We went through all that just to get here."</color>

At your words, she raises an eyebrow, thinks for a moment, then clicks her tongue.

<color=#a69085>"Sorry, but the deeper parts of the dungeon are blocked off... No one can get through. This is as far as you can explore for now."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN100_DESC:
A man carrying a large pack rests nearby with the relaxed expression of someone familiar with this place.

When he notices your gaze, he gestures for you to come closer.

<color=#a69085>"Hey, I’ve got some fine goods here. Care to take a look?"</color>

Though you eye him suspiciously, he does not seem hostile.

<color=#a69085>"And where exactly did you get all of this?"</color>

<color=#a69085>"Who knows... I just wander around and pick up whatever seems useful."</color>

He lets out a hearty laugh as he lays out his wares.
TEXTKEY_NodeN200_DESC:
A masked figure stands beside a wooden cage filled with insects. You make your presence known as you approach, but he seems more interested in the insects than in you. Without even turning his head, he points to an Acid Insect.

<color=#a69085>"They spew acid, yet their own bodies do not dissolve. Fascinating, is it not? I believe I could learn more by observing the moment they burst..."</color>

He casually tears a page from his notebook and hands it to you.

<color=#a69085>"Record the moment an Acid Insect bursts and report back to me. In return, I will share the results of my research."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN210_DESC:
When you nod, he becomes lost in thought once more.

<color=#a69085>"What process could produce acid inside its body...?"</color>

He begins scribbling in his notebook and appears to lose all interest in you.
TEXTKEY_NodeN211_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Me? I go wherever insects can be found."</color>

When he reaches through a gap in the cage, a Metal Scarab clacks its hard shell in warning.

<color=#a69085>"Every layer of the Dungeon has a different environment and concentration of mana. Even members of the same species mutate in completely different ways. To me, this entire place is a living laboratory."</color>

Even as you speak with him, you learn nothing about the figure behind the mask. You cannot be certain whether the stranger is a man, a woman, or even human.
TEXTKEY_NodeN300_DESC:
Xenon looks away from the Acid Insect and toward a nearby Spore Insect. As he watches it, the corners of his mouth slowly curl upward.

<color=#a69085>"At first, I thought it was merely a relative of the Acid Insect."</color>

When he prods the Spore Insect with a stick, it releases a cloud of spores.

<color=#a69085>"Creatures covered in those spores are wounded far more easily than usual. Yet it is neither poison nor acid."</color>

He frantically scribbles several lines in his notebook.

<color=#a69085>"The same kind of insect, yet it hunts in a completely different way... Beautiful."</color>

After a moment, he tears out a note and hands it to you.

<color=#a69085>"Observe a few Spore Insects as they burst. I want to know exactly what those spores are."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN310_DESC:
As you take the note, he nods in satisfaction.

<color=#a69085>"Ah, and don't forget: Spore Insects only inhabit deep within the forest."</color>

He looks back at the Spore Insect and mutters as if to himself.

<color=#a69085>"How can such tiny spores make creatures so weak..."</color>

As though he has already forgotten you are there, he immerses himself in observation once more.
TEXTKEY_NodeN400_DESC:
As you approach, Xenon flips through his notebook without much reaction. After a moment, he speaks.

<color=#a69085>"You're here."</color>

He taps a section of the open record with his finger. It is densely filled with sketches of a large grub and observation notes.

<color=#a69085>"I truly cannot understand this creature. Even as an adult, it has an enormous body but cannot move on its own. How does something like that sustain such a bulk?"</color>

He tears out a sheet of notes and hands it to you.

<color=#a69085>"Collect the Meat Grubs that inhabit the burrow region and keep records as you do. I want to know their secret."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN410_DESC:
Resting his chin on one hand, he mutters to himself.

<color=#a69085>"It seems like an insect that should have gone extinct long ago... What principle keeps it alive?"</color>

He immerses himself in his research once more.
TEXTKEY_NodeN500_DESC:
Xenon flips through several pages of his notebook, then opens it to a drawing of a dark crimson insect.

<color=#a69085>"There's a bloodsucking insect that goblin shamans apparently carry around and cherish for some reason."</color>

He props up his chin, lost in thought, and continues.

<color=#a69085>"Those creatures have nothing in common with intellectual inquiry. They're stupid and filthy! Hmm... What was I talking about again?"</color>

He scratches his head, then turns toward you.

<color=#a69085>"This time, I need to see a living specimen with my own eyes."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN510_DESC:
He looks back at the sketch of the insect and murmurs to himself.

<color=#a69085>"Do goblins... enjoy having insects drink their blood? How strange..."</color>

He strokes the gray-furred cat as he sinks into thought.
TEXTKEY_NodeN600_DESC: He appears too absorbed in his insect research to pay any attention to you.
TEXTKEY_NodeN700_DESC:
When you hand him your observation records, he silently opens his notebook and reads through them.

After a brief silence, his pen begins racing across the page.

<color=#a69085>"Oh... Fascinating."</color>

He studies the Acid Insect for a long while, then slowly nods.

<color=#a69085>"Its bodily fluids are highly acidic, yet its outer shell does not corrode at all. This is more than simple resistance to acid. There must be another mechanism at work... Magnificent!"</color>

As though you are no longer there, he stares at the Acid Insect and sighs in admiration.
TEXTKEY_NodeN800_DESC:
When you hand over your observation records, Xenon silently opens his notebook and reads through them.

<color=#a69085>"Oh... What an extraordinary discovery."</color>

He tips his head back, clutches his mask with both hands, and gazes at the Spore Insect as he mutters.

<color=#a69085>"These spores were slowly breaking down living tissue. It is neither poison nor acid, but something entirely new... Incredible!"</color>

He frantically fills several more lines in his notebook, then nods in satisfaction.

<color=#a69085>"I hope you will assist with my research again."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN900_DESC:
When you hand over your observation records, Xenon scans them quickly. After a brief silence, he clutches his head with both hands.

<color=#a69085>"Ah... Yes! That is it! Why did it take me so long to realize?"</color>

He opens his notebook and begins writing furiously, barely able to contain his excitement.

<color=#a69085>"It was not a creature that hunted for food at all. It was parasitizing the flesh of the colossal organism that makes up this entire layer, drawing nourishment directly from it."</color>

He twists with delight, unable to contain himself.

<color=#a69085>"Ha... What a brilliant survival strategy! This is marvelous!"</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1000_DESC:
When you hand Xenon the Hell Leech, he slips it inside his robe without a moment's hesitation. A smile soon curls across his lips.

<color=#a69085>"Ah... Yes. So that's how it works!"</color>

He removes the leech again, sways in a brief daze, then pulls out his notebook.

<color=#a69085>"They were forcibly awakening their spiritual senses through intense pain... and hallucinations."</color>

As though he has already forgotten you are standing beside him, he mutters to himself.

<color=#a69085>"I'll need to develop several more hypotheses about the mechanism behind these hallucinations. First..."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1100_DESC:
He is examining the golem wreckage.
He looks very tired.
TEXTKEY_NodeN1200_DESC:
Crouching on the floor as he examines the remains of a destroyed golem, he slowly turns to you, looking weary.

<color=#a69085>"It has been a long time since the Magic Empire fell. Much of what was left behind in the Dungeon has now lost even its meaning."</color>

As he slowly gathers the records scattered around him, he continues.

<color=#a69085>"But if devices once used and discarded by the Empire still remain... they would be a great help in understanding the Dungeon."</color>

He draws a sketch and shows it to you.

<color=#a69085>"If you find a mana device that looks like this, would you examine it and let me know?"</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1210_DESC:
When you accept the request, he gives a weary nod.

<color=#a69085>"Don't push yourself. A brief investigation will be enough.
That Magic Device is usually found somewhat deep within the Festering Burrow."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1211_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"The more the Guild understands the Dungeon, the easier exploration will become. We will know what dangers lie within and what we can make use of."</color>

He sets down the records he was organizing and looks at you.

<color=#a69085>"Of course, I am not asking for charity. Bring me useful information, and I will pay you what it is worth."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1300_DESC:
When you hand over the investigation report on the arcane device, Perion slowly reads through it with tired eyes.

<color=#a69085>"Hmm... As expected, it appears to use Imperial magical technology. And just as the records suggest, it seems extremely dangerous."</color>

After adding several notes to the report, he thanks you.

<color=#a69085>"The Dungeon draws vitality from the outside, processes it, and converts it into powerful magical energy. We may never understand the process completely, but..."</color>

He sighs as though the thought alone is giving him a headache.
TEXTKEY_NodeN1400_DESC:
Endrossi brightens when she notices you, but quickly looks away.

Pretending nothing is amiss, she rummages needlessly through her quiver before speaking.

<color=#a69085>"What? You again?"</color>

After a brief silence, she glances beyond the forest.

<color=#a69085>"The forest seems a little calmer lately. Tracking prey has become easier than it used to be."</color>

Freshly dressed hides, bones, and other spoils of the hunt are arranged neatly around her.
TEXTKEY_NodeN1411_DESC:
When you ask Endrossi to join the expedition, she turns her gaze beyond the forest.

<color=#a69085>"A gigantic monster lives beyond these woods—one that ordinary arrows can't even scratch. Even the finest hunter could lose their life to it in an instant."</color>

The arm holding her bow begins to tremble.

<color=#a69085>"I won't know a moment's peace until I've killed that beast and avenged my sister."</color>

You hear tightly restrained grief and fury in her voice.
TEXTKEY_NodeN1420_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Hoo..."</color>

She exhales slowly, struggling to contain her emotions.

<color=#a69085>"Be careful when it starts stamping the ground. That's the sign it's about to charge."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1421_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"My older sister was a renowned hunter even among our clan. She was the one who taught me how to hunt."</color>

As if to hide her trembling hand, she grips her bow tightly.

<color=#a69085>"I lost my way and wandered all the way into the Molded Burrow. My sister followed to find me... and that was where we encountered that monster."</color>

Endrossi bites her lip and stares beyond the forest.

<color=#a69085>"My sister faced it alone to save me, and I ran away like a coward. I will never know peace until I have avenged her."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1600_DESC:
While dressing her kill, she senses your presence and spins around.

<color=#a69085>“You had better not come any closer.”</color>

Her hand is poised to draw the bowstring at any moment. You slowly raise both hands and step back.

<color=#a69085>“We mean you no harm.”</color>

<color=#a69085>“...Guild expedition folk cannot be trusted. Every last one of you is weak.”</color>

She points to the carcass of an enormous beast sprawled at her feet and sneers.

<color=#a69085>“You will probably end up as Mawmurk food before long.”</color>

Several expedition members stiffen at her open provocation and start forward, but you raise a hand to restrain them.
TEXTKEY_NodeN1610_DESC:
The pile of game beside her still reeks of fresh blood.

<color=#a69085>"They have sharp noses. They tear into the weak and frightened first."</color>

She lets out a short scoff.

<color=#a69085>"So take my advice. Build skill, not bravado."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1611_DESC:
At your question, she narrows her eyes in displeasure.

<color=#a69085>“I have no reason to tell you.”</color>

<color=#a69085>“It seems you are not affiliated with the Guild.”</color>

<color=#a69085>“Are you saying I need the Guild's permission to hunt beasts?”</color>

The Guild classifies anyone who enters the Dungeon without authorization as an illegal explorer. When you point this out, she scoffs.

<color=#a69085>“If you intend to wave the Guild's rules in my face, forget it. I need no one's permission.”</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1700_DESC:
As you speak to her, she sits upon a nearby rock.

<color=#a69085>“Don’t get cocky just because you managed to hunt a mere Mawmurk.”</color>

She pulls out a piece of white fur from inside her coat and shows it to you.

<color=#a69085>“Around here, a white one appears every now and then. It rarely shows itself like the others, but it’s highly intelligent—clever enough to use even simple magic.”</color>

She brushes her fingers across the fur and adds mockingly,

<color=#a69085>"Don’t tell me you’re already trembling in fear?”</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1710_DESC:
She lets out a small laugh at your answer.

<color=#a69085>“White Mawmurks only inhabit the deep forest. Let me warn you in advance: they are no ordinary beasts. When they see people, they do not run away... they hunt.”</color>

Her fingertips slowly pluck at the bowstring.

<color=#a69085>“There is no shame in being afraid. Not that I am.”</color>

After a moment, she glances at you and shrugs.

<color=#a69085>“If you are really scared, you can quit anytime.”</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1800_DESC:
She nudges a pebble with the tip of her boot, as though something about the situation displeases her.

<color=#a69085>"You lot are better than I expected. Truly."</color>

But soon, something seems to cross her mind, and she falls briefly into thought.

<color=#a69085>“You know, there’s an alpha that leads the Slogel pack around here. That’s what I call it, anyway. Don’t go comparing it to the others. The thing’s bigger for starters… and once it starts rampaging, it melts everything around it...”</color>

Trailing off for a moment, she casually flicks her bowstring with her fingertips, feigning indifference.

<color=#a69085>“Not that I’ve ever had a reason to deal with something like that myself.”</color>

Then she gives you a once-over and lets out an amused scoff.

<color=#a69085>“If you run into it, run. And if you’re feeling bold enough to think you can take it on, I’d suggest thinking twice.”</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1810_DESC:
At your words, she is speechless for a moment. Then she furrows her brow and lets out a disbelieving laugh.

<color=#a69085>“...What? Are you insane?”</color>

She looks you over as though she cannot believe it.

<color=#a69085>“That thing is no ordinary monster. If you rush in carelessly, there will not even be anything left of you.”</color>

She quickly composes herself, then smirks.

<color=#a69085>“Well, fine. If you are that eager to die, I will not stop you. For your information, you will find it in the deepest part of the forest.”</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN1900_DESC:
Endrossi examines the traces of the Mawmurk you brought back and raises an eyebrow slightly.

<color=#a69085>“...Hmph.”</color>

She studies the evidence in silence for a moment before letting out a faint scoff.

<color=#a69085>“Well, at least you didn’t end up as Mawmurk feed. Though... I’d wager luck had more to do with it than skill.”</color>

Acting as though it’s no great matter, she tosses a few coins your way with a smirk.

<color=#a69085>"Here. Consider it the price of your life."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2000_DESC:
When you place the White Mawmurk’s head before her, her hand pauses for a moment. Without a word, she picks it up and inspects it slowly.

<color=#a69085>"So it was true. Hm... I honestly thought you lot would lose your nerve and run.”</color>

Running her fingertips across the white fur, she turns her gaze toward you.

<color=#a69085>“…I’ll admit it. Just a little.”</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2100_DESC:
When you show her proof of the hunt, her expression hardens.

<color=#a69085>“That monster couldn't have died so easily. Don't lie just to make yourself look impressive.”</color>

But eventually, she can find nothing more to say.

<color=#a69085>“...Hah.”</color>

She rubs a hand over her face and gives a bitter smile.

<color=#a69085>“Damn it. You're strong enough—more than strong enough. I hate to admit it, but it's true. Tch...”</color>

Then, suddenly self-conscious, she turns away with a haughty air to hide her embarrassment.
TEXTKEY_NodeN2200_DESC:
When you tell her the outcome of the hunt, she slowly closes her eyes and lets out a quiet breath.

<color=#a69085>"...It's over."</color>

She gazes up at the sky for a moment, then smiles faintly.

<color=#a69085>"My sister can finally rest in peace."</color>

She slings her bow over her shoulder and looks at you.

<color=#a69085>"I'll keep my promise. I'll head to the settlement first, so meet me there later."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2300_DESC:
She greets you while organizing the inventory.

<color=#a69085>"The guild handles a wide variety of goods. Ah, though things that can only be obtained in dungeons are a bit difficult for us to distribute..."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2400_DESC:
Neatly dressed hides and bones are arranged around her.

<color=#a69085>"Take whatever you need. Just make sure you pay a fair price."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2500_DESC:
She looks displeased.

<color=#a69085>"Hey Expedition Leader, we can't trade without a Trading Post."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2600_DESC:
A gaunt man sets down an enormous backpack and begins laying out his wares one by one.

When he notices you, his mouth twists into a sly grin.

<color=#a69085>"Ah, a customer. You've come at just the right time."</color>

He props up a large sign and taps it with one hand.

- Special discount today only!

<color=#a69085>"I'm in a generous mood today. Believe me, an opportunity like this doesn't come along often."</color>

He picks up one of his wares, makes a show of polishing it, then places it back on display.
TEXTKEY_NodeN2700_DESC:
Perion is examining a fragment of a golem. Without pausing as you approach, he speaks.

<color=#a69085>"...Thanks to you, my research has made considerable progress."</color>

He brushes his hair to one side, clearly dissatisfied.

<color=#a69085>"But there is still far too much we don't know about the Dungeon. Not being able to enter and see it for myself is becoming unbearable."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2710_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"An expedition... Not a bad choice if I am to investigate the depths of the Dungeon."</color>

After briefly scanning the mission papers, he mutters under his breath.

<color=#a69085>"But I still have orders to investigate the biological specimens the empire used for research. It must have been forbidden even then, yet it seems they experimented on living creatures as well..."</color>

Still looking weary, he makes you a promise.

<color=#a69085>"Find a specimen and examine it yourself. After that, I will join the expedition."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2720_DESC:
When you nod, Perion quietly nods in return.

<color=#a69085>"Understood. I've heard the Specimen is found in the deepest part of the Festering Burrow."</color>

He straightens the mission papers and resumes his notes.

<color=#a69085>"Be careful... There is no telling what may happen."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2800_DESC:
Perion silently reads through the investigation records you brought.

<color=#a69085>"Remarkable... This was no ordinary magical experimentation on living creatures. It means they were even studying the ancient beings themselves."</color>

After a moment's thought, he lets out a quiet sigh.

<color=#a69085>"As for what they hoped to accomplish... there is no way to know now."</color>

He neatly stacks the documents beside him and places them in his bag.

<color=#a69085>"I will keep my promise. Once I've finished the remaining work, I'll head to the settlement. From now on, I will investigate the Dungeon firsthand as a member of the expedition."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeN2900_DESC:
As you approach, the Chain Knight stares at you and the expedition members.
The members tense up and prepare for battle, but unlike before, it shows no sign of hostility.

<color=#a69085>"Target combat capability confirmed to be at a considerably high level. Sufficient survival probability secured."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Hey, you'd better explain what's going on. Otherwise, this time I'll turn you into a heap of scrap metal."</color>

You threaten it, but the Chain Knight remains unfazed.

<color=#a69085>"Impossible. The Dungeon's operation cannot be explained logically. At present, the truth cannot be reached."</color>

It disappears into the darkness, leaving behind one final statement.

<color=#a69085>"When the time comes, the path forward will open."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR010_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"That expedition was exhausting too! I want to sleep in a warm bed right aw..."</color>

With a loud stretch, {0} appears in front of the portal!
Several members' faces turn pale. 

{0} never returned from the dungeon, so how could they have come back like this?
TEXTKEY_NodeR020_DESC: It seems you should examine {0} closely before making a careful judgment.
TEXTKEY_NodeR100_DESC:
As you stare at {0} gambling with the expedition members over a game of dice, his attention turns toward you.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, just the person I wanted to see. Care for a round against me?"</color>

He briefly explains the rules of the game.

<color=#a69085>"It’s decided purely by luck, so nothing could possibly be fairer than this."</color>

He watches you closely, waiting for your answer.
TEXTKEY_NodeR110_DESC:
You won.

{0} rises from his seat with a bitter expression.

<color=#a69085>"Luck was on your side this time, Commander!"</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR111_DESC:
You lost.

Your hands tremble slightly as you hand over the gold coins. {0} grins smugly as he takes them.
TEXTKEY_NodeR112_DESC:
When you invoke expedition regulations and confiscate the entire pot, {0} looks utterly devastated.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, you can’t do this! This is tyranny!"</color>

You simply shrug and gesture for {0} and the expedition members to disperse.
TEXTKEY_NodeR200_DESC:
Whoooosh— THUD!!

Drawn by the loud commotion, you step outside to find expedition members gathered around a bird that appears to have just fallen from the sky, its elegant feathers shimmering in brilliant colors.

As they argue heatedly amongst themselves, {0} notices your arrival.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, this is... a Thousand-Colored Bird. A sacred creature treasured since ancient times for its mystical beauty. Yet this barbarian here insists on eating it. It’s absurd!"</color>

At {0}’s explanation, {1}, the one who caught the bird, reacts with visible agitation.

<color=#a69085>"En'tok! Lanzrai! Commander, the strong eat while the weak are eaten. We are strong, so we eat this bird. I do not understand why this should be stopped!!"</color>

Both of them stare at you, awaiting your decision.
TEXTKEY_NodeR210_DESC:
After informing the guild that a Thousand-Colored Bird had been captured, a buyer was fortunately found before long.

The buyer is overjoyed and willingly pays a hefty sum to acquire the creature.

<color=#a69085>"Unacceptable! This dishonors the rights of the hunter! I will never forget this! Kyarak'tu!"</color>

Though {1} protests furiously, your pockets grow noticeably heavier all the same.
TEXTKEY_NodeR211_DESC:
With swift and unhesitating movements, {1} slaughters the Thousand-Colored Bird and harvests its meat.

<color=#a69085>"No need to complicate things. What is hunted should be eaten well."</color>

Watching the scene unfold, {0} gradually turns pale.
TEXTKEY_NodeR300_DESC:
A raven quietly flies through the thorned vines and lands upon your forearm.
Its eyes slowly begin to glow with a faint blue light.

<color=#a69085>“There is someone who insists on joining your expedition, no matter what. I warned them several times that this is no place for foolish games, but they simply refused to listen.”</color>

The raven lets out a short caw and looks up at you.

<color=#a69085>“Since they remain stubborn, I have decided to leave the matter to your judgment. What will you do, Commander?”</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR310_DESC:
A new expedition member has joined.

<color=#a69085>"You’ve come a long way to get here. Welcome to the expedition."</color>

You warmly welcome the newest member of the expedition.
TEXTKEY_NodeR400_DESC:
While observing the thorned vines nearby, {0} approaches you and gestures urgently.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, I just saw something writhing over there..."</color>

You notice something moving beneath the thick layer of corruption.
TEXTKEY_NodeR410_DESC:
After struggling for quite some time within the corrupted zone, {0} eventually returns, grunting while dragging back a large and grotesque looking fish.

A sinister purple corruption clings thickly to {0}'s entire body.
TEXTKEY_NodeR411_DESC:
After stumbling about in the corrupted zone for quite some time, {0} eventually returns carrying an armful of strange items.

A sinister purple corruption sticks heavily to {0}'s entire body.
TEXTKEY_NodeR412_DESC:
After struggling through the corrupted zone for some time, {0} seems to discover something and ventures even deeper inside.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, I’ve never seen anything like this before."</color>

Returning from the depths of the corruption, {0} hands you a skull-shaped object with three eyes.

A sinister purple corruption clings thickly to {0}'s entire body.
TEXTKEY_NodeR500_DESC:
Late at night, while everyone is asleep, a long howl echoes from outside the settlement.

Awoooo!! Awoooo!!

Awakened by the sound, you step outside to find {0}, {1}, and the other Lycan expedition members raising their voices toward the enormous full moon.

<color=#a69085>"What in the world are you doing at this hour?"</color>

When you ask in bewilderment, {0} turns to answer.

<color=#a69085>"We are taught that the spirits of our ancestors dwell upon the moon. Even now, they run across endless fields and watch over their descendants."</color>

{0} looks back up at the moon and smiles.

<color=#a69085>"On nights when the moon is this large and bright, we believe our voices can reach our ancestors. It is an ancient Lycan tradition for us to howl together and let them know that we are well."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR510_DESC:
You sigh and shrug your shoulders.

<color=#a69085>"If that is your custom, then so be it. Just don't take it too far."</color>

The moment you give permission, the Lycan expedition members throw back their heads toward the moon as though they have been waiting all night.

Awoooooo!!

Awoooooooo!!

Thunderous howls echo throughout the settlement until the dead of night.

The next morning, the Lycan members begin their day looking strangely refreshed. The other expedition members, kept awake all night, can only glare at the Lycan members with hollow eyes between one yawn and the next.
TEXTKEY_NodeR511_DESC:
You furrow your brow and speak firmly.

<color=#a69085>"The others need their rest. That's enough for tonight."</color>

The Lycan expedition members exchange disappointed looks, then slowly lower their heads.

<color=#a69085>"...Understood, Commander."</color>

Quiet soon returns to the settlement. The other expedition members sigh in relief and, satisfied with your decision, return to their beds.

The Lycan members linger beneath the brilliant moon with regretful eyes, but eventually disperse in silence.
TEXTKEY_NodeR600_DESC:
While food rations are being distributed, dissatisfied voices begin to rise among the expedition members receiving their shares.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, exploring the Dungeon means putting our lives on the line. Must we skimp even on food every single time?"</color>

Before you can answer, several nearby expedition members nod in agreement.

<color=#a69085>"Exactly. We could die today or tomorrow."</color>

As more voices join in, the expedition members speak with growing conviction.

<color=#a69085>"We are not asking for more luxurious food. Just let us eat our fill, even if only for a while."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR610_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Thank you, Commander!"</color>

The expedition members receive meals more generous than usual and eat with visibly greater satisfaction.
TEXTKEY_NodeR611_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Survival requires restraint as well as strength in battle. I ask each of you to endure a little longer."</color>

Still plainly dissatisfied, the expedition members take their usual portions and leave.
TEXTKEY_NodeR700_DESC:
A raven flies over the thorny vines and lands before you.
Its eyes turn blue, and the Inspector's voice soon issues from its beak.

<color=#a69085>"Expedition Commander, I am preparing an evaluation of your expedition's recent operations."</color>

The raven tilts its head and looks at you.

<color=#a69085>"But in the end, it all comes down to people. If you showed just a little sincerity... I think I might find a bit more enthusiasm for the evaluation."</color>

You quickly recognize the Inspector's improper intentions and hesitate to answer.

<color=#a69085>"Hm, no, never mind. I was only saying it could be so."</color>

The raven fidgets in place, fluttering its wings as it waits for your answer.
TEXTKEY_NodeR800_DESC:
While discussing the expedition's operation with you, {0} cautiously speaks up.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, why don't we request expedition support from the Guild? Given our present circumstances, they may be willing to help."</color>

When you nod, {0} gives a short, off-beat signal whistle. Before long, a raven flies down and lands before you, opening a line of communication. You explain the expedition's situation and ask the Guild for support, but the Inspector sounds reluctant.

<color=#a69085>"Guild support must be prioritized. To send aid to you, I would have to divert resources meant for another expedition..."</color>

The raven lightly ruffles its wings before continuing.

<color=#a69085>"It won't do your reputation any favors. Still, considering your achievements thus far, it may not be impossible."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR900_DESC:
While surveying the area around the settlement, you notice something drifting slowly through the depths of the contaminated zone.

Wrapped in dark violet pollutants, it is being carried farther and farther into the depths by the current.

An expedition member beside you narrows their eyes and speaks cautiously.

<color=#a69085>"Commander... Is that a person?"</color>

You stare at it, unable to move for a long moment.

At this distance, you cannot tell whether the person is still alive—or whether it is already too late.

One thing, however, is certain: wait any longer, and they will drift beyond your reach forever, deep into the contaminated zone.
TEXTKEY_NodeR910_DESC:
The expedition members immediately plunge into the contaminated zone. Pollutants coil around their bodies, and dark violet liquid covers their armor and skin. No one has a moment to spare for their own safety.

After barely managing to seize the drifting figure and drag them out, one member checks their condition.

<color=#a69085>"Thank goodness. They're still alive!"</color>

The survivor regains consciousness a short while later and decides to remain with the expedition.
TEXTKEY_NodeR911_DESC:
The expedition members immediately plunge into the contaminated zone. Pollutants coil around their bodies, and dark violet liquid covers their armor and skin. No one has a moment to spare for their own safety.

After barely managing to seize the drifting figure and drag them out, one member checks their condition.

<color=#a69085>"No... They're already dead."</color>

Every expression hardens. While recovering the body, the expedition members discover a small amount of money.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1000_DESC:
{0} hears something moving swiftly through the nearby bushes.
After rummaging around for a while, they eventually catch something suspicious and bring it to you.

<color=#a69085>"Sshhhhk!"</color>

The strange creature, resembling a bundle of leaves, wriggles helplessly in {0}’s grasp before finally giving up.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, what should we do with this?"</color>

From what you can tell, the tiny creature does not seem particularly dangerous.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1010_DESC: {0} awkwardly scratches their head before deciding to keep the curious little creature as a companion.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1011_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"—Screeeeech!!"</color>

As {0} tears apart several pieces of the creature, a sharp cry echoes through the air.

Once it is completely dismantled, a tiny green essence is discovered at its core. At the very least, your curiosity has been satisfied.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1100_DESC:
In the silence, you think you hear a faint sound at first, but it gradually becomes clearer.
It is wonderfully soothing, yet at the same time far too strange to be described by any ordinary word.

One person marvels that it sounds like the call of a magnificent horn, while another insists it resembles the elegant melody of a harp.

Closing your eyes, you focus deeply and contemplate the true nature of the sound.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1200_DESC:
All of a sudden, you realize that something is watching you.
After finding nothing around you, you slowly lift your head and look toward the sky.

Above, the clouds gather into a strange and meaningful shape.
It seems almost alive, wearing a peculiar smile as though it possesses intent.

<color=#a69085>"Is this world filled with suffering... or pleasure?"</color>

Overwhelmed by its presence, you find yourself unable to move.

<color=#a69085>"Or perhaps... greed?"</color>

Instinctively, you choose your answer.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1210_DESC:
At your answer, the thing writhes violently before roaring in fury.

<color=#a69085>"Then suffering shall be your companion!"</color>

In an instant, unbearable agony crashes over you and the expedition members, as though both body and soul are being torn apart.
By the time you regain your senses, it has already vanished.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1211_DESC:
At your answer, the thing cries out in delight.

<color=#a69085>"Ahhh... then you shall be filled with pleasure!"</color>

At once, you and the expedition members are swept away by a wave of overwhelming ecstasy.
By the time you regain your senses, it has already disappeared.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1212_DESC:
At your answer, the thing claps with delight and cries out.

<color=#a69085>"Hahaha! Though greed itself knows no end!"</color>

Coins begin raining from the sky, and you and the expedition members scramble frantically to gather them.
By the time you regain your senses, it has already vanished.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1300_DESC:
While continuing the expedition, {0} informs you that they have discovered a strange crevice in a nearby cliffside.

<color=#a69085>"Looks like it’d hurt if you got poked by this."</color>

As you examine the gap thick with overgrown thorns, you notice something glimmering deep inside.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1320_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Agh!"</color>

{0} quickly pulls their hand back in pain, then turns toward you with a faintly resentful look.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, I don’t think there’s actually anything in there..."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR1321_DESC:
{0} carefully reaches deeper inside, enduring repeated pricks from the thorns.

Before long, after searching through the narrow crevice, they manage to find something.

<color=#a69085>"Hmm... this is..."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR1322_DESC:
{0} carefully reaches deeper inside, enduring repeated pricks from the thorns.

Before long, after searching through the narrow crevice, they manage to find something.

<color=#a69085>"Hmm... this is..."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR1400_DESC:
While leading the way through dense undergrowth, {0} suddenly loses their balance and pitches forward.

<color=#a69085>"Aagh!"</color>

You hurry over and find a thick, sticky vine wound tightly around {0}'s leg. Only after pulling with all your strength do you manage to tear it free.

{0} wipes away a cold sweat and glares at the vine.

<color=#a69085>"Even a massive bear would have trouble escaping once it set foot in these vines."</color>

You suddenly look deeper into the thicket where the vines extend.

Animal and human bones—apparently the remains of victims claimed long ago—lie scattered within. These vines do not seem to be plants that happened to grow here, but predators that have waited patiently for prey.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1420_DESC: {0} pushes through the sticky vines and searches deep inside, but finds nothing useful.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1421_DESC: {0} pushes through the sticky vines and ventures deeper inside. A short while later, they struggle back out with several bones clutched in their arms.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1422_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Commander... I found a strange vine."</color>

It looks like it could be quite useful.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1423_DESC:
When the expedition members throw their torches, the sticky vines begin burning fiercely and belching black smoke.

Once the flames die down, nothing remains but the powdery ashes of the bones.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1430_DESC:
When the expedition members throw their torches, the sticky vines begin burning fiercely and belching black smoke.

Once the flames die down, nothing remains but the powdery ashes of the bones.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1500_DESC:
While examining the nearby undergrowth, {0} motions for you to come closer.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, there's a burrow here."</color>

When you push aside the branches, a narrow burrow appears beneath the stump of a fallen tree. A few short hairs and a half-chewed root cling to the entrance.

The smell of earth and animals drifts from within. Its owner is nowhere to be seen.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1520_DESC:
{0} crouches down and crawls into the narrow burrow.

A short while later, they drag out four chunks of tough raw meat wrapped in dry leaves. Tiny incisor marks cover the meat. It is full of sinew, but has not yet spoiled.

<color=#a69085>"<color=#a69085>"It is edible."</color>"</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR1521_DESC:
{0} emerges from the burrow carrying two dirt-covered turnips.

Their leaves have been bitten short, and tiny incisor marks remain on their skins. Both are small, but still firm.

<color=#a69085>"Brush off the dirt and they should be edible."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR1522_DESC:
After rummaging deep inside the burrow, {0} crawls out cradling two lumps of damp clay.

The clay is quite fine and sticky, with hardly any stones or roots mixed in. Marks on the burrow walls show that the same clay was spread over them and left to harden.

<color=#a69085>"This is worth taking as well."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR1523_DESC:
Crouching low, {0} ventures deep into the burrow and rummages through a pile of dry grass.

Then a dry branch snaps in the bushes behind you.

A murmok appears with food clenched in its jaws. More emerge one after another behind it. They drop what they were carrying and raise their fur.

The moment {0} pulls free of the burrow, the murmoks charge.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1600_DESC:
Without warning, you feel as though someone is watching you.

You look around, but no one is there.

Then you glance down the cliff and see a mass of strangely shaped shadows writhing below.

As though possessed of a will of its own, the mass curls into an uncanny smile directed at you.

<color=#a69085>"What lies at the foundation of this world?"</color>

You try to look away, but some inexplicable force refuses to let you.

<color=#a69085>"Is it the surging wave? The flame that burns all things? Or nature, the cradle of life?"</color>

The first answer that enters your mind spills unbidden from your lips.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1610_DESC:
At your answer, the entity ripples gently and whispers as though smiling.

<color=#a69085>"Then... may the wave enfold you."</color>

In that instant, a transparent current washes over you and the expedition members.

It is not a violent force, but a warmth like a gentle embrace sinks deep into your bodies.

When you come to your senses, the entity has already vanished.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1611_DESC:
At your answer, the entity surges violently and cries out in a voice like roaring flame.

<color=#a69085>"Good... Burn everything!"</color>

In that instant, small flames spring to life across your body and those of the expedition members.

Strangely, the fire does not burn your flesh, yet it flickers ceaselessly as though eager to spread to everything nearby.

When you come to your senses, the entity has already vanished.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1612_DESC:
At your answer, the entity seems to smile with satisfaction.

<color=#a69085>"Good... Life must bloom by its own power."</color>

In that instant, warm life energy envelops you and the expedition members.

Gentle warmth seeps into every wound, and you feel your withered vitality slowly returning.

When you come to your senses, the entity has already vanished.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1700_DESC:
While surveying the area, {0} discovers something and calls you over.

<color=#a69085>"Commander, there are some strange markings here."</color>

Up close, parts of the image have been damaged, and its crude style makes it difficult to understand. Even so, you quickly recognize it as a mural left by goblins.

It depicts goblins hunting in groups, pursuing and bringing down wild animals.

{0} shrugs.

<color=#a69085>"Those monsters get up to all sorts of things, don't they?"</color>

You say nothing, gazing at the mural as you sink into thought.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1710_DESC:
The artwork is crude, but the sequence—driving the prey onward, surrounding it, and delivering the final blow—is depicted with astonishing precision.

The method gives you an idea for a new tactic, which you explain to the expedition members.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1711_DESC:
You take out your notebook and carefully copy the figures, their arrangement, and each stage of the hunt.

Crude though the mural may be, it appears to hold considerable value as research material.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1800_DESC:
A clamor begins to rise from across the way.

The pounding of drums, lively pipes, and murmurs in an unknown tongue mingle together and draw steadily closer. Soon, luminous humanoid figures—bright as flame—dance into view.

<color=#a69085>"We will become ?!@%@$%!(indecipherable)! Just as foretold, the price of ?!@%@$%!(indecipherable) flowers will soar beyond imagination!"</color>

They chatter in a fever of excitement, but you can understand almost none of what they say.

<color=#a69085>"At last, we will attain eternal life! We can solve everything, if only we can understand our own minds!"</color>

The otherworldly spectacle—the strange scent, off-beat drums, and wild dancing—leaves your thoughts increasingly hazy.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1810_DESC:
You stamp one foot, and the expedition members begin to catch the rhythm one by one.

Before long, the uncanny drums and pipes seep deep into your minds, intoxicating everyone. For a time, the expedition laughs and revels in an ecstasy none of you can explain.

When you come to your senses, the beings have already vanished. Yet the lingering thrill of that frenzy is slow to fade.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1811_DESC:
Strange smiles spread across their faces.

<color=#a69085>"Very well. Then we shall make you &%$&."</color>

In an instant, countless voices, images, and fragments of unknown knowledge flood into the minds of you and the expedition members.

Everything comes into sharper focus than before—but with that clarity, you also grasp truths you would rather never have known.

When you come to your senses, the beings have already vanished. You perceive the world more clearly than ever, yet at the same time feel an anguish you cannot explain.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1900_DESC:
{0} beckons you over.

In a narrow space concealed behind the wall, a skeleton lies collapsed. It remains frozen in place, one hand outstretched toward something beyond its reach.

The surrounding floor is covered in layer upon layer of intricate patterns and indecipherable writing. At the center of the circle lie an ancient censer and mana stones stained with dried blood.

The ritual appears to be over, yet the scene gives the unsettling impression that it stopped at the very last moment.

After examining the area, {0} speaks in a low voice.

<color=#a69085>"It looks like someone performed a ritual here. But... I don't think they ever completed it."</color>

The faint metallic scent of blood—blood that should have vanished long ago—still hangs in the air.

<color=#a69085>"Commander... If we interfere carelessly, we may end up just like this person."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeR1920_DESC:
As {0} begins the ritual, the patterns carved into the floor flare crimson.

<color=#a69085>"Ngh...!"</color>

As though something unseen is forcibly draining {0}'s life force, {0} clutches their chest and trembles in agony, barely managing to endure.

But nothing happens.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1921_DESC:
As {0} begins the ritual, the patterns carved into the floor flare crimson.

<color=#a69085>"Graaagh!!"</color>

An unseen force drains {0}'s life as though wringing the blood from their body.

The fresh blood spilling across the floor gathers at the center of the ritual circle, soaking the mana stones and filling them with an ominous crimson energy.
TEXTKEY_NodeR1930_DESC:
{0} searches around the ritual circle and carefully recovers anything that still appears useful. But just as they turn to leave, the sensation of a cold gaze crawls across their back.

Soon, unintelligible murmurs begin seeping into everyone's minds. You try to ignore them, but every whisper sends an icy shiver down your spine.
TEXTKEY_NodeT010_DESC:
You snap back to your senses as someone shakes your shoulders violently.

<color=#a69085>"Damn it!! Commander!"</color>

Cold sweat pours down your body like rain, and your first feeling is relief—you’re still alive.

Unfortunately, your first expedition ended in disaster after encountering the infamous <color=#a69085>Red Monster Rat.</color> Not long after, all you and your team could do was flee for your lives.

<color=#a69085>"It seems… we're the only ones who made it."</color>

Lowell, the one who woke you, lowers his head in despair.
You had scoffed at the grim rumors about this dungeon before being dispatched here, thinking them exaggerated.
Now, you understand their meaning better than anyone.
TEXTKEY_NodeT910_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Aaaah!"</color>

You hear a scream nearby—and instantly recognize the voice as Liana's, one of your companions.

She's surrounded by a swarm of rats and soon collapses under their attack.
TEXTKEY_NodeT1100_DESC:
<color=#a69085>"Haaah..."</color>

With help, she barely manages to rise and struggles to catch her breath.

<color=#a69085>"What about Jack and Ivan? They were with you."</color>

Her expression darkens at your question. Having expected that reaction, you immediately give the order.

<color=#a69085>"Then we should hurry and get out of here. We need to find a portal somewhere on this layer."</color>

<color=#a69085>"Commander, I know where the portal is. But the Barren Land outside has nothing but thorny vines and withered trees. We should gather resources here before we return."</color>

You nod at her suggestion.

You slowly look over the expedition members gathered nearby. Their slumped shoulders and hollow, weary eyes are steeped in fatigue and discontent.

<color=#a69085>"We won't be able to explore properly in this state. We need to help everyone regain their spirits."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeD010_Rank1Resource1:

Wood is an important resource used in many areas, including equipment crafting and construction.

<color=#a69085>"As you all know, we need more wood."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeD010_Rank1Resource2:

<color=#a69085>"We need to secure more cloth before we run critically low."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeD010_Rank1Food:
You realize that the food reserves are running out faster than expected.
For expedition members who risk their lives in the field, proper meals matter more than anything.

<color=#a69085>"We won’t last long on empty stomachs. We need to hurry and secure more food."</color>
TEXTKEY_NodeD010_Rank1Level:

<color=#a69085>"If we are to survive, we need to become stronger than we are now."</color>

TEXTKEY_ScenarioType_CrawlingDoom_DESC:
<color=#807b79>As the leader of the expedition dispatched by the guild, your objective is to stop the slowly awakening dungeon core.

Having lost most of your expedition members to overwhelming enemies, you must continue the expedition relying on the supplies provided by the guild.</color>
TEXTKEY_ScenarioType_CrawlingDoom_FLAVOR:
- This is the most basic starting point.
- A tutorial is available.
TEXTKEY_ScenarioType_BalanceTestLv1_DESC:
(TemptText)In the dark night, only bullets whistle across the prairie,
On the battlefield, only the wind weeps,
And the stars flicker faintly.
This dark night, ah, I know you have not fallen asleep.
And by the child's cradle, you quietly wipe away your tears.
How deeply I love you, your tender, loving eyes; how I long to kiss you now.
This dark night separates us, my love, this restless black prairie divides us.
TEXTKEY_ScenarioType_BalanceTestLv1_FLAV: This is for testing purposes. It is the most basic starting point.
TEXTKEY_ScenarioType_Establish_DESC: <color=#807b79>For hazardous expedition. Small wages, barren land, long darkness, constant danger, safe return doubtful. Honour and recognition from the Guild in case of success.</color>
TEXTKEY_ScenarioType_Establish_FLAVOR: - Choose 4 expedition members to take with you.
